Ultimate: things are empty of inherent existence. The opponent's error: demanding ultimate-level existence for conventional truths.","commonMisconception":"NOT saying conventional truth is \"false\" and ultimate is \"true.\" Both are TRUTHS at their respective levels. Tables, people, suffering, the path — all conventionally true. This is the level at which the Four Noble Truths operate.","realLifeExample":"The sun \"rises\" and \"sets\" — conventionally true (it appears that way and we navigate by it). Not ultimately true (the earth rotates, not the sun)."},{"q":"What is ultimate truth?","a":"Paramārtha-satya: the way things ultimately are — empty of inherent existence, dependently arisen. Not what appears (we don't feel the rotation)."},{"q":"Why are both needed?","a":"Conventional truth without ultimate truth → attachment to appearances (taking them as inherently real).
